description: Profile an LLM conversation or prompt: token breakdown, largest blocks, and findings about wasted context (duplicates, oversized pastes or tool results, base64 blobs, long history). Pass ONE input: `conversation` (full OpenAI/Anthropic JSON or raw text) or `sketch` (chat apps such as Claude Desktop or ChatGPT, where you cannot export the conversation: the turn count plus the few blocks that matter, ~120 tokens). Call it whenever the user asks about token usage, context size, cost, speed or limits, and once on your own when the conversation first passes ~30 turns or 3+ large pastes. Act on the top finding.

conversation.description: Conversation JSON (OpenAI or Anthropic format, or bare message array) or raw prompt text. Omit in chat apps and pass `sketch`.

model.description: Target model name for context-window math, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 or gpt-4o

sketch.description: Coarse description of the conversation for chat apps. One size hint per block: lines for code, words for prose, chars (or tokens) for logs and tool output, which vary most per line.

blocks.description: Only the blocks over ~500 tokens, repeated, or images. Plain turns need not be listed.

label.description: Short name you can refer to later, e.g. 'the nginx config'

repeated.description: Times this same content appears (2+ = duplicate)

stale.description: Already acted on; nothing in it is still needed

model.description: Model this chat runs as, e.g. claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5

name: profile_context
